pages.text: Hold any of Iron's staffs in either hand (or an item in the #frieren_arcana:flight_staves tag). Double-tap jump for ordinary flight; the staff you hold appears beneath you. Mana drains only while flying.

pages.title: Which staff?
pages.text: Any of Iron's staffs works, in either hand, so the other hand stays free. Modpacks can add more items to the $(o)#frieren_arcana:flight_staves$() item tag. While you fly, the staff you hold is drawn beneath you.
